release_notes:
BD MIL OFFICE 1.0.12 — 12 Oct 2026

Layout
- Database, Typewriter, Intel Scan and File Parse now use the whole screen. Their bottom panels stopped a quarter of the way up and left empty space below.
- Landscape fixed everywhere: Word, PowerPoint, Database, Typewriter, Intel Scan and File Parse all reach the bottom now.
- Typewriter in landscape: the action buttons moved to the foot and the input box takes the space above, instead of being the smallest box on screen.
- Database in landscape: the abbreviation list is wider, so fewer entries wrap.
- Intel Scan: the top-left pane no longer has its corners clipped.
- Typewriter: the output box no longer looks like it crosses the panel edge.

Fixed
- Go to page follows the system light/dark theme instead of staying in the old colours.

Privacy
- An unused API key that earlier builds bundled inside the app is gone. No ads, no tracking, nothing to log in to.

Notes
- If the update fails, uninstall the previous version and install this one.
